CTRH.RaiseBlockedByElevation: That token is underneath one standing at a higher elevation, so it cannot be raised by reordering alone.
CTRH.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable rescue bar
CTRH.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Show the bar of covered tokens when you hover a token that is sitting on top of others.
CTRH.Settings.Threshold.Name: Coverage threshold
CTRH.Settings.Threshold.Hint: How much of a token must be hidden before it counts as covered. 1.00 requires it to be completely buried; lower values catch partial overlaps.
CTRH.Settings.IconSize.Name: Portrait size (pixels)
CTRH.Settings.IconSize.Hint: The on-screen size of each portrait in the bar.
CTRH.Settings.ScaleWithZoom.Name: Scale with canvas zoom
CTRH.Settings.ScaleWithZoom.Hint: When enabled the bar shrinks and grows with the canvas, matching the old behaviour. When disabled it keeps a constant size on screen, which stays readable when you zoom out.
CTRH.Settings.ShowUnowned.Name: Include tokens you do not own
CTRH.Settings.ShowUnowned.Hint: List every visible covered token. Turn this off to show only the tokens you can control.
CTRH.Settings.Highlight.Name: Outline token on hover
CTRH.Settings.Highlight.Hint: Draw a dashed outline on the canvas over the token a portrait refers to.
CTRH.Settings.RaiseOnSelect.Name: Bring the token to the front when selected
CTRH.Settings.RaiseOnSelect.Hint: Clicking a portrait also raises that token above the ones burying it, so you can drag and click it on the canvas. This changes the token's draw order for everyone at the table, and only works on tokens you own. Turn it off to leave the canvas untouched and only select the token.
CTRH.Settings.Placement.Name: Bar placement
CTRH.Settings.Placement.Hint: Where the bar is drawn relative to the hovered token.
